currency.basis: Live official site https://priovtb.com/ fetched 2026-10-02 presents АО/ПАО «Прио-Внешторгбанк» and references local/templates/project/dist/images/icons/logo.svg and logo-xs.svg in its active Bitrix header/footer; homepage shows 2026 campaign content. CBR registry (cbr.ru/finorg/foinfo/?ogrn=1026200000111, license #212, OGRN 1026200000111) shows an operating license dated 2016-01-29 and no revocation record.

identity.basis: Fetched homepage identifies the site as Прио-Внешторгбанк and the record title is Прио-Внешторгбанк (RU). The mark in logo-xs.svg is the same emblem used in the site-wide logo lockup (four rounded corner brackets around a ring-and-disc emblem), so the asset belongs to this bank record.

assessment.independenceRationale: The official site is the primary source for the asset; the CBR registry independently confirms the legal entity, license number and operating status. These are different publications, not mirrors.

variant.basis: logo-xs.svg (28x28 viewBox 0 0 28 28) is the compact mark-only variant that the official site itself uses site-wide; it contains no separate lettering. Verified fills in the fetched bytes: #d9007e and #00b295 (researcher note claiming teal-only was wrong; source inspected directly). Full horizontal lockup logo.svg (141x36) includes the wordmark and is unsuitable for a square cell; the mark-only variant is the official standalone form.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All source contours survive: the magenta rounded-square silhouette with its four notched corner cutouts, the transparent ring between square and disc (verified showing the dark background through on the dark-theme pair, i.e. true internal alpha, not white fill), and the teal disc. Fills remain exactly #d9007e and #00b295; SVGO floatPrecision 4 changed only 27 of 50176 preview pixels (sub-pixel antialiasing) in the working-vs-optimized raster comparison.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Square 28x28 emblem fills the cell with the geometry the official site itself uses for its compact icon; no scaling, translation or backing transform was applied, so proportions are the source's own. The mark stays recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes because it reduces to three high-contrast simple shapes.
candidate.rationale: First addition: the record has no icon.svg. The official compact mark variant of Прио-Внешторгбанк is an original two-color vector served by the bank's own live site; it is a standalone emblem without accompanying lettering and is therefore suitable for the catalog square cell.
candidate.role: Standalone bank mark (the emblem-only compact variant of the official logo lockup); the magenta rounded-square contour is the branded silhouette, not an empty canvas.
transforms: None: final.svg is the original fetched vector after source-preserving SVGO 4.1.0 optimization (config /workspace/svgo.config.mjs sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e, multipass, floatPrecision 4); 1629 -> 1051 bytes (-35.5%); optimized version selected after raster comparison against the working copy showed no visible change. candidate.variant: Official compact icon-only variant (logo-xs.svg) of the current brand mark, used site-wide on priovtb.com; distinct from the 141x36 lockup which carries the wordmark.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: there is no base icon; the diff is absent-to-real-icon. No pre-existing design is modified or replaced.

proposals.reason: First addition for bank 4399: no icon.svg exists. Live official site uses a two-color vector mark; compact mark-only variant is a suitable standalone icon. Raster inspection and this judgment performed on 2026-10-02.
